tasks.short: Hold office hours and assist students

steps.what: Read the student's actual work and locate the relevant assignment instruction during the visit
Remain available during scheduled office hours and advise and assist the student with the actual question

tasks.design: Link the current assignment instruction directly to student work in {LMS}. Keep reading the work, scheduled availability and actual assistance with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: A teacher could reopen the assignment page separately while discussing a student's work.
tasks.enabler_now: A native assignment link can remove that navigation, without summarizing the student's work.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding a student's confusion takes direct discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher responds to the student rather than a generic answer.

ambition.what: Office-hour availability and advice rights remain the same.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native assignment links can remove navigation while student-work reading and office-hour assistance stay human.

assumptions: Boundary is a substantive office-hour visit within the existing scheduled window. Termly scheduling is not charged anew to each visit; existing calendar publication earns no new saving.

The student produces the actual work; the teacher reads it in s1. The instruction is the teacher's existing assignment, with course and assignment identifiers already held in the learning system. No new capture is priced as today's work.
The link removes only1 of20 source-reading/navigation units;19 remain for actual reading and interpretation. If already linked, new gain is zero.

This visit is oral assistance without a separately kept case record. Do not invent a trailing attendance or progress note. Actual written annotations or a later formal advising record, if present in a different episode, must be counted separately.
Native configuration first; no helper or automated student answer. Shares are unmeasured activity estimates, independent of the prompt time-share prior.
unknowns: Whether the current assignment is already linked
Actual mix of visits and reserved availability
research_questions: Is there any repeated assignment-page navigation left after current native settings?

already_counted.description: Actual reading, interpretation, availability and office-hour conversation remain counted.

incremental.description: Check the assignment link after course revisions.

tasks.short: Advise students on curricula and careers

steps.what: Read the actual student plan and locate current academic, vocational and career reference entries
Discuss the student's goals, prior study and practical constraints
Advise on suitable curricula and career options and explain tradeoffs and uncertainties
Update the actual working student advising plan with options and follow-up questions
Save the working advising plan in its existing store

tasks.design: Configure programme-version and subject filters in {DOCS} and link relevant entries from {LMS}. The teacher still understands goals, gives advice and updates the actual working student plan used at the next advising visit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant current requirements and career entries could require repeated navigation across reference pages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native programme, version and subject filters can remove that navigation while preserving source reading.
tasks.still_hard: A student's preferred career may conflict with practical constraints or uncertain opportunities.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher helps the student weigh options without making the choice for them.

ambition.what: No admission, placement or credential decision rights are added.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reference filters can shorten curriculum retrieval while individualized advice stays human.

assumptions: Episode is a real curriculum-and-career advising visit with an existing working student plan, read at this and later advising visits. Do not add a record to an informal chat where none is kept.

Student context comes from the actual student account and existing plan. Reference producers maintain programme identifier, effective version, subject and source locator; teacher verification and missing-link handling remain in s1.
The configured view removes5 of20 source-navigation units, retaining15 for actual reading and checking. Test current native filters first; already available filtering earns zero new gain.
No registration, recommendation send, placement commitment or final credential decision is hidden in the plan. Any such actual action needs its real authority and own final-version step.
Save1 is near-zero fully retained and ungated; shares are unmeasured estimates independent of the task prior.
unknowns: Existing plan use and reference metadata
research_questions: Which current programme entries are repeatedly located during real advising visits?

already_counted.description: Source reading, student discussion, advice and real student-plan authorship remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R95 gives gross5 less upkeep1, net4. Low: programme versions are not indexed consistently, retaining19 of20 lookup/reading units;1 saved covers1 upkeep, net0. Student discussion and the actual reused advising plan remain fully retained.

tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research

steps.what: Read the actual student's work and the applicable supervision objectives
inputs: student teaching, internship or research work

steps.what: Observe the student's actual practice and assess progress against the supervision objectives
Supervise and discuss the student's methods, difficulties and next steps
Write the actual working supervision comments used to check progress at the next meeting
Save the ordinary supervision comments in the same store

tasks.design: Keep actual supervision with the teacher, using the existing linked objectives in {LMS} and working-comment template in {DOCS}. Those native aids already cover available retrieval and formatting; no additional helper is justified for this episode.
tasks.previous_blocker: The remaining work is reading unique student work, observation and developmental judgment.
tasks.enabler_now: No new change beyond the existing linked objectives and comment template is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Student progress and appropriate next steps depend on actual work and context.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognizes difficulty, builds judgment and gives responsive guidance.

ambition.what: Supervision and assessment rights do not change.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct student supervision requires observation and contextual judgment; a template does not remove unique substantive feedback work.

assumptions: Boundary is actual recurring supervision with working comments that are read at the next progress meeting. Where no such comments are kept, remove that real record branch rather than adding paperwork.

The student produces the work; the teacher reads and observes it in s1-s2. Existing course and objective links already provide retrieval, with no new data capture or free structured student evaluation assumed.

The actual record write is separate from conversation. Native headings and linked objectives are already used; they do not decide or write the individualized observations. No additional repeated transfer remains to automate in this episode.
No final grade, certification or external placement report is hidden in the ordinary comments. Actual formal decisions or sends need their own final authority and action.
Save1 is near-zero fully retained and ungated. Zero incremental upkeep is justified because no new helper is introduced; shares are unmeasured estimates.
unknowns: Whether another site has real duplicated student-status transfer
research_questions: After native templates are used, is there any actual repeated transfer distinct from substantive supervision?

already_counted.description: Student-work review, observation, conversation and real reused supervision comments remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new helper or recurring upkeep is introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and upkeep0, net0. Both cases retain actual source reading, observation, conversation and individualized working-comment writing; existing linked objectives and template formatting earn no new saving.

tasks.short: Select and obtain textbooks and teaching supplies

steps.what: Read actual course requirements, available stock and current supplier descriptions
Review actual textbooks and supply samples for subject accuracy and course suitability
Select exact editions and supply quantities and capture the supplier and delivery details
Populate the exact selected item, edition, quantity and delivery fields in the final order package
Perform the actual institution's purchasing-authority review of the completed order
Transmit the exact authorized order to the selected supplier
Receive and inspect the actual delivered textbooks and supplies against the order
Write the actual factual delivery status used to track outstanding teaching materials
Save the factual delivery-status entry in the same system

tasks.design: Configure {PROCUREMENT} to assemble exact teacher-selected order fields and transmit the completed package only through the institution's actual purchasing-authority route. Keep textbook review, selection, physical receipt and the factual outstanding-material status with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected material details could be recopied into an order and transmitted separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue and order fields can assemble the selected lines and route the released package.
tasks.still_hard: Edition changes and unsuitable teaching content require substantive review.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher selects materials that fit the actual curriculum and learners.

ambition.what: No expanded purchasing or budget authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selected catalogue fields can populate an order and a real authorization route can release its exact transmission.

assumptions: Episode is an actual materials purchase using the institution's existing separate purchasing authority; do not invent approval work for a route that does not have it.
The teacher captures supplier identifier, item identifier, exact edition, quantity, price and delivery location in s3. Source and suitability work is counted in s1-s2; missing fields remain manual.
Final order exists before s5. Any item, edition, price, quantity, supplier or location change voids a1. Test native order-field reuse first; existing automated orders earn no new gain.

The supplier send is a real external commitment, distinct from the ordinary save. Actual supplier fulfilment is not teacher saving. s8 is factual status used to track outstanding materials, not a formal payment or goods-acceptance release.
Same-system save1 is near-zero fully retained and ungated. Shares are unmeasured estimates based on these activities.
unknowns: Actual procurement authority and native order reuse
research_questions: Which selected fields still require real re-entry before the supplier order?

Actual existing purchasing-authority review remains counted outside the teacher denominator.
